overview: QA Automation Engineers write automated test scripts, build testing harnesses, and ensure high reliability, performance, and security across software release cycles.
learning_roadmap: Master manual testing concepts: Test plan creation, test case design, black-box vs white-box methodologies.
Learn automated UI testing frameworks: Playwright or Cypress with JavaScript/TypeScript, or Selenium with Python.
Master API testing automation using Postman, Newman, and Pytest / Requests.
Integrate automated regression test suites into GitHub Actions or Jenkins pipelines.
interview_topics: Page Object Model (POM) design pattern and maintainable test architecture.
Flaky test mitigation and explicit vs implicit wait strategies.
API response validation: Status codes, schema validation, latency SLAs.
Bug life cycle and defect severity vs priority prioritization.
diu_campus_advice: Software testing is a major hiring domain for top local companies like Brain Station 23, BJIT, and Therap Services. Showcase automated test suites in your projects.

overview: DevOps Engineers automate infrastructure provisioning, continuous integration and deployment (CI/CD), system observability, and cloud security.
learning_roadmap: Attain mastery of Linux CLI, shell scripting, system permissions, and network sockets.
Containerize microservices with Docker, multi-stage builds, and Docker Compose.
Learn CI/CD automation: Automated linting, testing, image building, and automated deployment.
Master Kubernetes architecture: Pods, Deployments, Services, Ingress, and ConfigMaps.
Provision reproducible cloud infrastructure with Terraform.
interview_topics: Docker internals: Namespaces, cgroups, layered filesystem, and image size optimization.
Kubernetes pod lifecycle and rolling zero-downtime deployment strategies.
Infrastructure as Code (IaC) state management and drift detection.
Observability triad: Metrics, Logs, and Distributed Tracing.
diu_campus_advice: Earn an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner or Kubernetes CKA certification during 3rd/4th year to stand out in the campus recruitment drive.

overview: Mobile App Engineers build performant, responsive native and cross-platform applications for iOS and Android smartphones and tablets.
learning_roadmap: Master modern cross-platform frameworks: Flutter (Dart) or React Native (TypeScript).
Understand mobile architectural patterns: MVVM, Clean Architecture, BLoC pattern.
Integrate hardware features: Camera, GPS, biometrics, offline local sync.
Publish at least one functional app to Google Play Store.
interview_topics: Flutter widget tree: StatelessWidget vs StatefulWidget vs RenderObject.
React Native bridge and new architecture (Fabric, TurboModules).
App performance: Frame rates (60fps/120fps), memory leaks, and startup time.
Offline-first synchronization patterns and conflict resolution.
diu_campus_advice: Showcase working APK download links or live Google Play Store listings on your CV.
